explanation: The theorem says the Borel subgroup of GL₂(F), for an infinite field F, is maximal among solvable subgroups. Mathlib has no Borel subgroup of GL(Fin 2) F and no maximality results for solvable subgroups of GL. I grepped Mathlib's GroupTheory and LinearAlgebra directories for "Borel", "le_of_isSolvable_of_not_isSolvable" and "not_isSolvable_fin_two", with no matches. I also grepped all of Mathlib for "upperTriangular", "BorelSubgroup" and "IsSolvable.*GeneralLinearGroup". The only hits were unrelated lemmas about parabolic elements in GeneralLinearGroup/FinTwo.lean. The proof uses only declarations from the library itself (GL2Borel, GL2WeylElement, a double-coset lemma, and non-solvability of GL₂ over an infinite field).
